overall_goal: Peel and finely slice the onion

goals.description: Prepare the workspace and halve the onion
goals.rationale: The person retrieves an onion, clears the chopping board, and cuts the onion in half to prepare for peeling.

goals.description: Peel and trim the onion halves
goals.rationale: The person removes the skin from both onion halves and trims the ends with a knife to fully peel them.
The person slices both onion halves in multiple directions to create small chunks, removing any remaining skin found during the process.

goals.description: Discard scraps and transport the sliced onion
goals.rationale: The person removes the leftover onion root and carries the chopping board with the sliced onion to another area.
